verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability to instantly freeze or block a lost or stolen card, and nothing about ordering a replacement for one. Card-ordering APIs and spending-permission toggles exist, but these are adjacent features for building card programs, not a documented freeze-and-replace flow.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly freeze a lost or stolen card and order a replacement

citations.quote: Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
With this set of APIs, you will be able to create cards for your customers.
